title: Lunara Skincare
subtitle: Brand Identity & Web Design
overview: A complete brand identity and web design project for a luxury skincare brand, including logo design, packaging, signage, and a fully functional website with online ordering system.
challenge: Create a memorable brand identity that captures the essence of a premium skincare experience while developing a user-friendly website that drives online orders and customer engagement.
solution: Developed a refined, modern brand identity with a custom logo, cohesive visual system, and a responsive website featuring an intuitive ordering flow and product photography that reflects the brand's premium positioning.

sections.title: Brand Identity
sections.content: The Lunara brand identity centres on calm, elevated visuals that communicate quality and care. The logo features a custom wordmark with a subtle crescent motif, while the colour palette uses soft, natural tones that evoke balance and luxury.

sections.title: Ideation and Logo Development
sections.content: The creative direction focused on fluid forms and gentle movement, expressing the natural flow of skincare. The logo design process explored soft curves and rounded letterforms, with the letter 'L' featuring a crescent moon shape to tie into the name 'Lunara'.
